# Awesome ChatBI

> 🌟 A curated list of **ChatBI** (AI-powered conversational business intelligence) — open-source platforms, commercial products, semantic layers, frameworks, benchmarks, papers, tutorials and real-world cases.

> 🌟 收录 **ChatBI / 智能问数** 相关的开源平台、商业产品、语义层、技术框架、基准与论文、教程与真实案例的精选导航。

**[简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)**

**ChatBI** (Conversational Business Intelligence, also *GenBI / AI 问数 / 对话式 BI*) lets users ask questions in plain language and get answers — tables, charts, insights — generated by LLMs on top of a data warehouse. It sits at the intersection of **NL2SQL / Text2SQL**, **semantic layers**, **data agents** and **traditional BI**.

This list maps the whole ecosystem: what you can self-host today, what to buy, what to build on, what to read, and how to choose.

**Topics:** ChatBI · AI 问数 · NL2SQL · Text2SQL · Semantic Layer · Data Agent · Conversational BI · GenBI

> ⭐ Star counts are approximate snapshots and change over time.

```
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │  User asks a question in natural language            │
        └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                                ▼
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │  ChatBI application layer                            │
        │  chat UI · multi-turn sessions · chart rendering ·   │
        │  dashboards · explanation of results                 │
        └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘

        └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                                ▼
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │  Semantic layer & context                            │
        │  metrics · dimensions · business glossary ·          │
        │  RAG over docs & example queries (few-shot)          │
        └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                                ▼
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │  LLM layer                                           │
        │  general LLM prompting · fine-tuned SQL models ·     │
        │  embeddings · rerankers                              │
        └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘

        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │  Data layer                                          │

        │  PostgreSQL · Snowflake · BigQuery · Databricks ...  │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Key Concepts

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **NL2SQL / Text2SQL** | Converting a natural-language question into an executable SQL query. The technical core of ChatBI. |
| **ChatBI / GenBI** | A conversational product on top of NL2SQL: chat UI, multi-turn context, charts, follow-ups. |
| **Semantic Layer** | A governed abstraction of metrics/dimensions (e.g. "revenue") so the LLM generates correct SQL against business definitions. |
| **Schema Linking** | Mapping question terms to actual tables/columns; usually the biggest accuracy bottleneck. |
| **RAG for ChatBI** | Retrieving DDL, docs, metric definitions and past Q→SQL pairs as context (few-shot) to boost accuracy. |
| **Execution Accuracy (EX)** | Benchmark metric: does the generated SQL return the correct result set (not just string-match). |
| **Exact Match (EM)** | Benchmark metric: is the generated SQL text identical to the gold SQL. Stricter, less meaningful. |
| **Data Agent** | An agent that not only writes SQL but plans multi-step analysis, calls tools and reports findings. |

## Commercial Products

> Proprietary ChatBI / conversational analytics. Many connect to mainstream warehouses (Doris, StarRocks, ClickHouse, Snowflake …) via MySQL/PostgreSQL-compatible protocols.

### China / 国内

- **帆软 Dora** — FanRuan's AI 智能问数 assistant (FineReport / FineBI family); ask questions, get charts and narrative analysis.
- **帆软 FineBI** — BI platform with AI 问数; officially documented in the Apache Doris ecosystem.
- **阿里云 Quick BI（智能小 Q）** — NL query + insight generation on Alibaba Cloud.
- **百度 Sugar BI（智能问数）** — Baidu's BI with conversational querying.
- **腾讯云 BI / 数据洞察** — Tencent Cloud BI with AI chat analysis.
- **火山引擎 DataWind / 智能数据洞察** — ByteDance's BI with AI features.
- **网易有数** — NetEase YouData, BI + AI assistant.
- **亿信 ABI** — intelligent BI + AI 问数.
- **永洪 BI（Yonghong）** — BI with AI assistant.
- **观远数据（Guandian）** — consumer/retail BI with AI features.
- **Smartbi（思迈特）** — BI + 对话式分析.
- **Kyligence Zen / Kyligence AI** — metrics platform + semantic layer + AI.
- **衡石科技 HENGSHI SENSE** — embedded analytics with NL query.
- **数势科技 SwiftAgent** — LLM-driven data analysis agent for enterprises.
- **袋鼠云 数栈 / 滴普科技 / 明略科技** — data platforms adding 问数 capabilities.
- **SelectDB** — the commercial vendor behind Apache Doris; AI-oriented features.

### Global

- **Microsoft Power BI Copilot** — conversational analytics inside Power BI.
- **ThoughtSpot** (Spotter / Sage) — NL search and AI-generated insights.
- **Tableau Pulse / Tableau Agent** (Salesforce) — AI-assisted analytics & metric digests.
- **Qlik Sense** (Insight Advisor) — augmented analytics.
- **Google Looker + Gemini** — conversational BI in Looker.
- **Amazon QuickSight Q** — NL business questions with ML.
- **Snowflake Cortex Analyst / Snowflake Intelligence** — text-to-SQL over your Snowflake data.
- **Databricks Genie / Assistant** — conversational analytics in the lakehouse.
- **MicroStrategy Auto** — NL bot/auto-dashboard generation.
- **Oracle Analytics AI**, **SAP Joule / Datasphere**, **Domo AI**, **GoodData AI**.
- **Sigma Computing**, **Zenlytic**, **Fabi.ai**, **Hex Magic**, **Julius AI**, **DataChat**, **Tellius**, **AnswerRocket**, **Obviously AI**.

> Note: verify vendor support for a specific warehouse (e.g. Apache Doris) on the vendor's official docs — it changes quickly.

## Benchmarks & Datasets

**Widely used NL2SQL benchmarks**

| Dataset | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| **Spider** | Classic cross-domain text-to-SQL benchmark (Yale). |
| **Spider 2.0** | Enterprise-grade, real-world SQL workflows — much harder. |
| **BIRD** | Large-scale benchmark focused on **execution accuracy** and dirty data. |
| **WikiSQL** | Early large single-table dataset (largely saturated). |
| **SParC / CoSQL** | Multi-turn conversational text-to-SQL. |
| **Dr.Spider** | Robustness-oriented diagnostic benchmark. |
| **Archer** | Bilingual (English/Chinese) NL2SQL benchmark. |
| **CSpider / DuSQL** | Chinese text-to-SQL datasets. |
| **TableBench** | Table question-answering / reasoning benchmark. |

## How to Choose

| If you want… | Start with |
| --- | --- |
| A ready-to-run OSS 问数 system | **SQLBot**, **SuperSonic**, **DB-GPT** |
| NL2SQL embedded in your own app | **Vanna**, **WrenAI**, **sqlglot** + your LLM |
| Accuracy on business metrics | A **semantic layer** (**Cube**, **dbt/MetricFlow**) + LLM |
| A desktop tool for analysts | **Chat2DB**, **WhoDB**, **openhare** |
| To add chat to existing BI | **Superset / Metabase / DataEase** + AI assistant, or a commercial BI |
| An enterprise-supported product | **帆软 Dora**, **Quick BI**, **ThoughtSpot**, **Power BI Copilot** |
| To fine-tune your own SQL model | **DB-GPT-Hub**, **SqlCoder**, **PremSQL** |

**Practical evaluation criteria**

1. **Data source coverage** — does it speak your warehouse's dialect (Doris/StarRocks/ClickHouse/…)?
2. **Accuracy mechanisms** — RAG on DDL+docs? few-shot examples? semantic layer? self-correction loop?
3. **Governance** — per-user row/column permissions, audit logs, no data leaves the boundary?
4. **Deployment** — SaaS, self-hosted, or air-gapped/offline?
5. **Multi-turn & follow-ups** — does it keep context across questions?
6. **Cost** — tokens per question, caching, and whether a small model suffices.
7. **Evaluation** — can you run your own gold Q→SQL set and measure execution accuracy?

## Data Source Compatibility

ChatBI tools usually connect through standard drivers/protocols. Frequently asked about:

| Database | Typical connection | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Apache Doris** | MySQL protocol (port 9030) | Supported by SQLBot (official docs), DB-GPT, jimureport, Aix-DB and most MySQL-compatible clients |
| **StarRocks** | MySQL protocol | Same ecosystem as Doris |
| **ClickHouse** | HTTP / native | Broadly supported |
| **MySQL / PostgreSQL** | Native | Universal support |
| **Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks** | Native SDK/warehouse APIs | Common in commercial products |

> If a tool "supports MySQL", it can usually reach Doris/StarRocks too — but verify dialect-specific SQL generation quality.

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please open a PR and follow these guidelines:

- **Verify before adding** — include the repository link and, where possible, note the supported data sources.
- **Tag each entry** as *open-source*, *commercial*, *framework*, *semantic layer*, *research*, or *tutorial*.
- **Keep star counts approximate** (e.g. `★12.3k`) and update stale ones.
- **One line of rationale** — say *why* it is worth listing, not just what it is.
- Follow the [Awesome list guidelines](https://github.com/sindresorhus/awesome).

Ideas for contributions: real-world case studies, non-English resources, evaluation results on Spider/BIRD, benchmark comparisons, and deployment guides.
